description:
Infrastructure Engineer at Salterton Networks

Salterton runs a CDN for small and mid-size ecommerce brands. 80 POPs across 34 countries. Fully remote team of 18 engineers.

We're hiring for our platform team. You'll
- Own the provisioning layer for new edge nodes. End-to-end: hardware orders, network config, TLS bootstrap, health checks.
- Migrate our fleet from our old config-management setup (a custom Go thing) to Terraform + Ansible.
- Be second on-call for core CDN incidents. About 6 hours per week on average, fewer once the runbooks stabilize.
- Write runbooks. We expect them to be good enough that junior engineers can execute them at 3 AM.

Hard requirements
- 5+ years of infra experience, ideally at an edge/CDN/hosting company.
- Strong with Terraform and Ansible (or strong signal you could be within a month).
- Linux internals, Netfilter, BGP basics. You don't need to be a network engineer but you should know what a routing table is.
- Go for anything custom. Bash when it's simpler. Python for scripts.

What would make you stand out
- Experience running a multi-region fleet at >1k nodes.
- Prior on-call at an infrastructure company.
